svg.title: KPV doses people post vs. the doses behind the research
svg.desc: Log-scale chart of daily KPV amounts for a 70 kg adult. Doses posted on X in September and October 2026: 0.2 to 0.5 mg, some users 1 to 2 mg. The mouse colitis dose, 100 micromolar in drinking water, scales by FDA body-surface conversion to about 50 mg a day (range 37 to 74). The 1991 patent proposed 0.2 to 3.5 mg per kg per day, 14 to 245 mg. The patent rat paw test used 100 mg per kg of a modified form, about 1,129 mg human-equivalent.
